Sheet.TurnOrderHint: Roll Notice for the order of play: everyone rolls, the most successes goes first. The Margin's Grace and Error don't count.

gift.hint: A Gift is a Trait: it says how, and a skill still says what. It never rolls on its own.

athletics.label: Athletics
athletics.hint: Climbing, running, enduring pain and exhaustion. Resist pain with it.

aim.label: Aim
aim.hint: Anything you point or throw: stunners, flare guns, a well-thrown spanner.

lore.label: Lore
lore.hint: History, theology, culture, politics, the founders, the rites and songs of Compline; also rumors, who to ask, which stall knows a guy.

science.label: Science
science.hint: Biology, chemistry, astronomy, the Greens, analysis.

notice.label: Notice
notice.hint: Perception, investigation, reading people, spotting lies.

composure.label: Composure
composure.hint: Fear, temptation, concentration under strain, the Bound's feelings bleeding into you. Resist fear and the Bound with it.

systems.label: Systems
systems.hint: Terminals, data, sensors, code; getting a Bound-run interface to do what you want without asking nicely.

hullcraft.label: Hullcraft
hullcraft.hint: Repair, engineering, Bound machinery; also making things.

persuade.label: Persuade
persuade.hint: Talking, haggling, lying, intimidating, performing. Resist by arguing back.

procedure.label: Procedure
procedure.hint: Bureaucracy, law, forms, the Checklist, the official record. Resist bureaucratic pressure with it.

survival.label: Survival
survival.hint: Fieldcraft, foraging, shelter, hostile environments, animals.

navigate.label: Navigate
navigate.hint: Star charts, plotting jumps, finding your way across a strange world or through the Sump.

Skill.CostHint: Skills are bought with unspent Tenure. They stop at rating 2.

Deny.creationBudget: That's more than the 15 Tenure creation budget.
Deny.noRefund: Skills can't be lowered once creation is finished. Ask the GM.

Stamps.Label: Stamps
Stamps.Hint: Earned on every roll with a Hindrance (or the Drawback) in play, on a Margin of Grace, and for withdrawing from a scene. Spend: Expedite (+1 die before a roll), Refile (reroll one failed white die after it, from its chat card), Countersign (give a Stamp to an ally, to use as their Expedite or Refile), Reclassify (a Major that lands on you directly becomes a Minor), Amend the Scene (add a Trait to it), Negate (cancel the GM's Complication).
Stamps.SessionHint: Stamps up to what your Grade begins each session with: 2, and one more at Grades III, VI and IX.
Stamps.CountersignHint: Give one of your Stamps to another character, to use as their Expedite or Refile. You don't need to be there.
Stamps.NoAllies: There is no other character to give a Stamp to.

Tenure.Label: Tenure
Tenure.Hint: Spent on skills and Traits. Grade follows Tenure earned, never what you've spent. Add Tenure on the History tab.

Scrutiny.Label: Scrutiny
Scrutiny.Hint: The ship pushes back. The GM starts each session with one per player, and gains 1 whenever a Margin comes up as an Error, and spends it on complications.
Scrutiny.ShowHint: A small window showing the GM's Scrutiny to everyone at the table.
Scrutiny.StartHint: Scrutiny starts each session at one per player. You can also top every player's Stamps up to what their Grade begins a session with.
Scrutiny.StartPlayers: Scrutiny to start with (one per player)
Scrutiny.StartStamps: Top up the Stamps of the {n} player characters
Scrutiny.StartMinors: Clear the Minor Notices of the {n} player characters (they clear at the end of a session)
Scrutiny.SpendHint: Say what it is in the story. (A Complication, Raise the Rating and a Dissonance have their own buttons, on roll cards and in the Hum.)

Spends.push: Push the Deadline of the Docket in {card} up a round
Spends.stepUp: A Minor NPC acts as Major for one exchange

Track.Heading: Notices
Track.ClearMinorsHint: End of session: clear all Minor Notices.
Track.Overflowed: The track was full: the Notice escalated.
Track.ClearsByHint: blank = the default for its type
Track.TreatHint: Treated: this Notice is dealt with and its box clears.
Track.Escalate: Both Minor boxes are full. This Notice escalates to a Major. Continue?
Track.EscalateOut: Both Minor boxes and both Major boxes are full. This Notice takes you out of the scene (Final). Continue?
Track.ReclassifyHint: Spend a Stamp: this Major lands on you as a Minor instead. Only a Major that lands directly (a Commended or Denied result), not a Minor that overflows.
Track.Reclassified: Reclassified with a Stamp: one step lower.
Track.ReclassifiedAway: {name} spends a Stamp to Reclassify: "{notice}" does not land.
Track.WithdrawHint: Before a roll that could take you out, concede. Narrate your own exit, skip the Final box, and earn a Stamp.
Track.WithdrawNpcHint: Before a roll that could take them out, they concede: they narrate their own exit and skip the Final box.
Track.WithdrewNote: A clean exit: the Final box is skipped.

Npc.RatingHint: Used directly as the Difficulty of any roll against this NPC, or to resist them. 1 ordinary, 2 tough, 3 nemesis, 4 reserved.
Npc.TagsHint: When a Tag applies, the player loses a die (NPCs never roll, so their edge is always the player's −1). Only one Tag applies to any roll. Make a dangerous NPC tougher with a higher Rating, not more Tags.
Npc.RoleTagHint: Who they are. When they act within that role, or a player acts against them in it, the player loses a die.
Npc.ExtraTag: This NPC has more Tags than its tier carries (Background: the Role Tag only; Minor: one other; Major: two). They're kept, but shown only at a tier that has room.

NpcTier.backgroundHint: Toughs, crowds, clerks: any Notice takes them out.
NpcTier.minorHint: One Minor box; the next Notice, or any Major, takes them out.
NpcTier.majorHint: A full Notice track like a PC; can Withdraw.

Pool.Title: Build a Pool
Pool.GiftNote: Adds no die. Turns one white die violet (or adds one violet die to a pool that is only the Margin).
Pool.EncumbranceNote: If any Hindrance is in play you earn a Stamp, whatever the dice show, and the Margin of Error widens to 1–2. On an Error the GM complicates the scene through it. Hindrances never add dice, and never touch violet dice.

SceneSource.token: Your token is on this card. Change it if that's wrong.
SceneSource.active: Using the active scene. Change it if you're somewhere else.
SceneSource.none: No scene found. Pick one if it applies.

Pool.NoTraits: Fill in Station and your Traits on the sheet to use them here.
Pool.CommendationHint: Tick a Commendation when its situation applies.
Pool.SceneTraitHint: You may pick one scene Trait for +1 die.
Pool.StretchShort: Counts as 1 die, whatever its rank (the GM's call).
Pool.StretchNote: A stretch to fit the situation (the GM's call): the Trait counts as 1 die whatever its rank.
Pool.SecondTrait: Your Commendation lets a second Trait also apply.
Pool.BoundNote: Gear running on divine infrastructure turns one white die violet. At most one die from gear and one from the Gift.
Pool.GearHint: Gear never adds dice: the right tools let you roll at all.
Pool.ExpediteNote: Spend a Stamp for +1 die before you roll. Once per roll. (After the roll, Refile rerolls a failed die.)
Pool.PenaltyHint: Anything in the way, say −1, −2 or −3: darkness, wind, missing tools, a Notice on you, or an NPC's Tag that applies (only one Tag ever applies to a roll). Each point costs a die, down to the Margin alone.
Pool.HelpNote: Others are assisting: +1 die in total, however many help.
Pool.NoticeOnTargetNote: You are using a Notice an NPC carries against them: +1 die.

Modes.act: Acting against someone (their Rating is the Difficulty)

Pool.GreaterBoundNote: The GM's call, for an especially large or volatile Bound: Dissonance on 1–2.

Roll.Floored: Pool reduced to the Margin alone.
Roll.GraceText: Something goes unexpectedly right: a detail, a helping hand, or a Stamp.
Roll.ErrorText: The GM gains Scrutiny, to spend on a twist when they choose.
Roll.DissonanceText: Something has gone wrong with the Bound. A sour note.
Roll.MarginTarget: The Margin succeeds on {n}+ at this Grade.
Roll.UpgradeNote: A Commendation turns With Conditions into Approved.
Roll.ImpossibleNote: {name}: the GM allows the normally impossible.

GiftEffect.die: The Gift adds one violet die.
GiftEffect.convert: The Gift turns one die violet.
GiftEffect.none: The Gift has no white die to turn violet.

Roll.TurnOrderNote: Turn order roll: the Margin's Grace and Error don't count.
Roll.ErrorBites: Your flaw bites: the GM complicates the scene through your Hindrance.
Roll.BoundNoEffect: Bound gear has no white die to turn violet: no effect.

Card.ActiveHint: The active scene: where everyone falls back to when their token isn't standing on a card.
Card.DescriptionPlaceholder: What it looks, sounds and smells like.
Card.TraitsHint: Short phrases about the place. A roller can pick one of them for +1 die, and the GM can spend Scrutiny on one against a roll.
Card.AmendHint: Spend a Stamp to add a new Trait to this scene (a steam pipe bursts, useful scrap turns up, a hatch was unlocked all along). Amend the card you're on: your Section, if the Location has them. Anyone who can plausibly use it may pick it for +1 die; the GM may add one small detail.
Card.AmendNote: Anyone who can plausibly use it may pick it for +1 die. The GM may add one small detail.
Card.TraitNote: A note on how it works (optional)
Card.NoCharacter: You need a character to spend a Stamp. Select your token first.
Card.NoGM: A GM has to be online to add a Trait.
Card.PaintFailed: Could not paint a scene card for the tabletop. The token will show its plain art. Check that this world's folder can be written to.
Card.RepaintHint: Paint this card's token on the tabletop again from the card as it is now.
Card.Repainted: The card's token has been repainted.

Traits.BuyHint: A new open Trait slot (maximum six).
Traits.BuyBody: A new open Trait costs {cost} Tenure. Buy it?

Deny.max: You already have six open Traits.
Deny.needTenure: A new open Trait costs 4 Tenure.

Rank.Hint: Rank 1 adds 1 die; rank 2 adds 2. Raising a Trait to rank 2 costs {cost} Tenure and needs Grade {grade}.
Rank.Title: Raise a Trait to rank 2
Rank.Body: Raising this Trait to rank 2 costs {cost} Tenure. Raise it?

Deny.needTenure: Raising a Trait to rank 2 costs 6 Tenure.
Deny.noLower: Only the GM can lower a Trait's rank.

Traits.AwardHint: The GM may award a Trait after a major story moment: a new open Trait, free (up to six).
Traits.AwardPlaceholder: Walked Out of the Quiet Dock

Grade.Label: Grade
Grade.Hint: Set by lifetime Tenure earned: every 6 Tenure earns the next Grade. Grade sets your Stamps per session, the Margin's success threshold, and your Commendation slots, and unlocks Trait rank 2 at Grade III.
Grade.ReachedNote: Seniority is the ship's real wealth.

Creation.Label: Creation
Creation.Hint: 15 Tenure to buy skills, maximum rating 2. The standard spread is three skills at 2 and three at 1.
Creation.FinishBody: After this, skills are bought with Tenure you earn, and can't be lowered. Station, Traits and Hindrances stay editable.

Encumbrance.Heading: Hindrances
Encumbrance.Hint: Two troubles. If any is in play you earn a Stamp, whatever the dice show, and the Margin of Error widens to 1–2. They never add dice.
Encumbrance.personalPrompt: a flaw (Can't Leave a Machine Unfixed)
Encumbrance.circumstantialPrompt: an obligation or situation (Censured Once, Watched Ever Since)
Encumbrance.ResolveButtonHint: The story has resolved this Hindrance: it becomes a Trait, and you write a new Hindrance.
Encumbrance.ResolveHint: "{old}" becomes one of your Traits (free). Write the Hindrance that takes its place.
Encumbrance.Resolved: Resolved a Hindrance: "{old}" became a Trait. New Hindrance: {now}.

Gift.Heading: Gift and Drawback
Gift.Hint: Touched gifts are small, specific and quiet: useful, inconvenient, and occasionally both. A Gift adds no die of its own: it turns one white die violet (or, if you would roll only the Margin, adds one violet die). Its Drawback works as a third Hindrance.
Gift.DrawbackHint: The inconvenient side of the same Gift.
Gift.DrawbackPrompt: the other side (Hears Them When They're Hurting)
Gift.DrawbackNote: In play, the Drawback is an Hindrance: it widens the Margin of Error and earns a Stamp.
Gift.RegisteredHint: Being unregistered makes a good circumstantial Hindrance.

Commendation.Heading: Commendations
Commendation.Hint: Because I [short phrase], when [specific situation], I [one rule-break]. Slots come at Grades II, V and VIII.
Commendation.SituationPlaceholder: when I Hullcraft against the clock
Commendation.difficulty: Treat the Difficulty as one lower

History.Heading: History
History.Q2: Did you learn something Chorus didn't tell you?
History.Q3: Did you bend a rule that should have held?

Complication.Label: Complication
Complication.Hint: Spend 1 Scrutiny on one of this scene's Traits: one success fewer. The player can negate it with a Stamp.
Complication.Title: Complicate this roll
Complication.Prompt: Which Trait of {scene} gets in the way? It costs 1 Scrutiny and takes away one success.
Complication.Text: {trait} gets in the way: one success fewer (the GM spent 1 Scrutiny).
Complication.NegatedText: {trait} got in the way, but a Stamp was spent to negate it.
Complication.NegateHint: Spend a Stamp to cancel the Complication.

Register.Title: Register With Gloss
Register.Name: Name
Register.TouchedYes: Yes, I think I might be.
Register.ButtonHint: Walk through creating this character, one question at a time.
Register.AutoSetting: Open Register With Gloss for new characters
Register.AutoHint: When you create a character, Gloss walks you through it. You can always skip to the full sheet.

Hum.Label: The Hum
Hum.Hint: How much the Bound are stirring. Only you can see this.
Hum.Private: Players never see this. They feel it only through the world.
Hum.DissonanceHint: A Dissonance you trigger, as though a violet die had shown a 1: costs 1 Scrutiny, and adds 1 to the Hum.
Hum.RefrainRule: From here, every violet die causes Dissonance on 1–2.
Hum.GivesBody: Write the event and show it in the world. When it has played out, reset the Hum to 0.

still.name: Still
still.text: The ship sings as it always has.

murmur.name: Murmur
murmur.text: Small wrongnesses: a light in the wrong color, a door that hesitates.

refrain.name: Refrain
refrain.text: Districts notice. Liturgists hold vigils; Engineering files reports. All violet dice cause Dissonance on 1–2.

swell.name: Swell
swell.text: Ship-wide events. Chorus issues notices it won't explain.

gives.name: Something gives
gives.text: A campaign event, written by you.

expedite.hint: Spend a Stamp to roll one more die on your own roll. Once per roll.
expedite.title: Expedite
expedite.text: {who} spent a Stamp: one more die, a {value} ({hit}).

countersign.hint: Spend one of your Stamps to roll one more die on this ally's roll. Once per ally.
countersign.title: Countersigned
countersign.text: {who} countersigned with a Stamp: one more die, a {value} ({hit}).

raise.hint: Spend 1 Scrutiny: the NPC's Rating is one higher for this roll.
raise.title: Rating raised
raise.text: The GM spent 1 Scrutiny: the Rating is one higher for this roll.

CardAction.None: You have no Stamp to spend.

refile.hint: Spend a Stamp to reroll one failed white die. Once per roll.
refile.title: Refiled
refile.text: {who} spent a Stamp to refile a die: a {was} became a {value} ({hit}).

Brief.Label: Station Briefs
Brief.Name: Brief
Brief.Hint: A Brief is a starting point, not a class. It fills in your Station and skills and offers Traits, Hindrances and a Gift as suggestions. Change any of it, or take the whole Brief at once with Quick create.
Brief.SkillsNote: Filled in from the {name} Brief. Change any of it.
Brief.QuickHint: Fills in your Station, two Traits, two Hindrances and skills from the Brief (and its Gift and Drawback, if you're Touched), then reads it all back. Change anything afterwards.
Brief.QuickNote: Built from the {name} Brief. Go Back to change any answer, or edit the sheet later.

Docket.Heading: Docket
Docket.Hint: A job that builds up over several rounds, against a Deadline. Only you see this. The table sees just the running count of successes, on the card's token.
Docket.JobPlaceholder: Vent the compartment before the jump
Docket.PushHint: A Margin of Error, or spend Scrutiny: the Deadline moves up one round.
Docket.CountHint: Every success fills a box, whatever the result tier. On a roll's chat card, use Count to add its successes (a Margin of Error on it moves the Deadline up).

Result.cost: It works, at a real cost.
Result.half: It half works: something saved, something lost.
Result.fails: It fails. The story goes on from there.

Docket.CountTitle: Add this roll's successes to the scene's Docket. Only you see this button.
Docket.Pushed: A Margin of Error: the Docket's Deadline moves up a round.

Gear.Heading: Gear
Gear.Hint: Gear is permission, not a bonus: the right tools let you roll at all, and it never adds dice. Bound gear (anything running on divine infrastructure) turns one white die violet; with no white dice it does nothing. Exceptional gear is a Trait.
Gear.BoundHint: Runs on divine infrastructure: in a roll it turns one white die violet.
Gear.CreationNote: New characters start without Bound gear: it is lent, issued or earned in play.
Gear.OnLoanHint: Bound gear is lent, issued or requisitioned. The GM can approve keeping it for good.
Gear.KeptHint: This Bound gear is yours for good.
Gear.KeepHint: Approve keeping this Bound gear for good. It costs the character Tenure (and, naturally, a registration form).
Gear.NeedTenure: Keeping Bound gear costs {cost} unspent Tenure.
Gear.KeptLog: Kept Bound gear for good: {name} ({cost} Tenure).

Proceedings.Heading: Summary Proceedings
Proceedings.Hint: A whole situation settled with one roll per player against a Rating: a chase through Stem-Side, a day surveying a world. If at least half the group reaches Approved, the scene is won. Only you see this.
Proceedings.CountHint: On each roll's chat card, use Add to count it as that player's one roll. Then narrate it as a montage built from everyone's rolls.
Proceedings.CountTitle: Record this roll as the player's one roll in the scene's Summary Proceedings. Only you see this button.

Story.carry: carries the moment, plus a bonus (find something, save someone)
Story.price: contributes, but takes a Minor Notice
Story.slip: takes a Major, or the thing they were protecting slips

act.conditions: You each take a Minor Notice.

resist.commended: No harm, and you can turn it around.
resist.denied: You take a Major Notice (Reclassify can make it a Minor), and the GM tells their triumph in full.

record.none: Chorus answers none of your questions.
record.one: Chorus answers one question: true, exact and literal.
record.many: Chorus answers {n} questions: true, exact and literal.

Place.Heading: Location and Sections
Place.NoLocation: Nothing: this is the whole Location
Place.PartOfHint: When the space matters, give each Section a card of its own, part of the card for the whole Location, and lay the Section cards on top of it. A token is on the smallest card under it; a roll there may use one Trait from the Section or from the Location.
Place.LinksHint: Where you can go from here. Free unless marked Hazard (crossing takes a roll), Locked (it has to be opened first) or Long (getting there takes your turn).

Migration.Speaker: Gloss
Migration.AttuneMoved: A small notice about {name}'s record: the skills have changed. Attune is retired, and its rating has moved to Composure (now {rating}). There are also three new skills at 0: Aim, Systems and Navigate. Working with the Bound now uses the skill for what you do: Hullcraft for their machines, Lore for the rites, Persuade for one that talks, Composure to hold steady.

Share.CardHint: Let every player open this card and Amend it, or hide it again. Places from a one-shot or People & Places start hidden. Its token on the map is seen either way.
Share.NpcHint: Put this NPC's picture and name on every player's screen. They never see the stat block.
